summary: Backend-only retest of the 'rejected transaction still counted in totals' fix. Created a new dedicated suite /app/backend/tests/test_rejection_exclusion.py (16 tests) covering: admin reset -> tender -> STAFF-created pre_tender EMD Rs.12,84,394 (requested) -> ADMIN reject -> dashboard/tender-pnl/payables assertions; reversal exclusion; and non-rejected regression. Also re-ran the existing iteration-3 suite. Serial run (-n 0): 46 passed / 3 failed (49 total). THE REPORTED BUG IS FIXED: rejected txns are fully excluded from pre_tender_cost, post_tender_cost, admin_cost, total_actual_cost, emd_outstanding, gross_contribution, operating_contribution, payables, pending_approvals, /reports/payables and tender-pnl (pre_total/post_total/total_cost/contribution/margin), while still appearing in the transactions list and /details with payment_status='rejected'. NEW BUG FOUND: the REVERSAL path now double-counts the reversal - totals go NEGATIVE instead of 0.

critical.issue: Reversed transactions are DOUBLE-excluded, producing negative totals. POST /api/transactions/{id}/reverse (server.py ~L770-791) inserts a contra transaction with amount = -abs(original) and is_reversed=False/payment_status='paid', and flags the original with is_reversed=True. is_valid_cost() now drops the original, but the negative contra entry is still summed. Reproduced: create post_tender expense Rs.50,000 (paid) -> post_tender_cost = 50000 (correct) -> reverse it -> post_tender_cost = -50000 and tender-pnl post_total = -50000 (expected 0). This also poisons every subsequent figure: after adding a valid Rs.7,000 txn, total_actual_cost showed -43000 instead of 7000 and gross_contribution/contribution were wrong by the same amount.

minor.issue: Now requires body {"confirm":"RESET"} and returns 422 without it (previously accepted an empty body). Breaking contract change - the iteration-3 test had to be updated. Verify the frontend reset button sends the confirm payload.
missing_proof counts txns with payment_status in ('paid','approved') without excluding is_reversed/reverses_txn_id, so each reversal contra entry adds a false 'missing proof' action item.

action_items: Fix reversal aggregation: either (a) also exclude the contra entry from cost sums (e.g. add `not t.get('reverses_txn_id')` to is_valid_cost / cat_group / item_cost), or (b) keep the original included and let the negative contra net it out - do NOT do both. Currently both are applied, yielding -amount.
Apply the same reversal exclusion inside tender_pnl.cat_group() and item_cost.
Confirm the frontend Admin Reset action posts {"confirm":"RESET"} since the endpoint now 422s on an empty body.
critical_code_review_comments: is_valid_cost() is defined inline inside dashboard() while tender_pnl() and item_cost repeat the same three predicates inline - extract one module-level helper so a future change can't drift across endpoints (this duplication is exactly what caused the reversal case to be missed).

reverse_txn() copies the whole source document (rev = dict(existing)) including document_id, reconciled flags and paid_by; this makes the contra entry indistinguishable from a real expense in every aggregation that does not explicitly check reverses_txn_id.
/app/backend/server.py is 1293 lines - close to the 700-line guideline; split routers (auth, transactions, reports, admin) into modules.
Dashboard loads up to 5000 transactions and aggregates in Python on every request; move to a MongoDB aggregation pipeline before data grows.
seed_data_creation: DB was reset twice via POST /api/admin/reset {"confirm":"RESET"}; created TEST_REJ_001 tender plus TEST_ prefixed txns; final test_99_cleanup resets the DB again so the DB is left empty.

context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: run pytest with -n 0 (serial). Both tests/backend_test.py and tests/test_rejection_exclusion.py call POST /api/admin/reset, so under the pytest.ini default -n 2 --dist loadscope they run in parallel workers and destroy each other's data (produced 10 spurious failures). Serial run: 46 pass, only test_11/test_12/test_13 in test_rejection_exclusion.py fail, all traceable to the single reversal double-exclusion bug (test_13 is a cascade of the -50000 leak and should pass once the reversal fix lands). Rejection exclusion (tests 01-09, 14, 15) is fully green. Frontend was not exercised this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: Original user-reported bug (rejected txn counted in Pre-Tender Expenses / Total Expenses / Contribution / EMD Outstanding) is resolved by is_valid_cost() in the dashboard endpoint and the equivalent inline guards in tender_pnl. However the same guard introduced a regression for reversals: the double-entry design already neutralises a reversed txn by inserting a mirroring -amount contra row, so excluding the flagged original as well subtracts the amount twice. Net dashboard/PnL cost becomes -amount instead of 0. Fix: treat the reversal pair as a unit - skip rows where reverses_txn_id is set in cost aggregations (recommended, keeps the is_valid_cost is_reversed check), or drop the is_reversed check and rely solely on the contra entry.
